title: when tool feedback is filed as a slice, check it against slices that landed after the feedback's run, and drop or link it when one already covers it

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The spec check of S605 reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork, project ork, item S605:

when tool feedback is filed as a slice, check it against slices that landed after the feedback's run, and drop or link it when one already covers it

Evidence: S605 was filed from run ork-20261125-222936-fc21 on 2026-11-25 with empty sections; S597 landed 2026-11-26 and added the VIEW-WxH.txt rule to the ui prompt.

Today `FileToolFeedback` (`internal/engine/toolfeedback.go:282-294`) compares a new slice's title only with unfinished items (`NearDuplicateTitles` skips done and retired items, `internal/engine/neardup.go:37`). A slice that already landed and covers the feedback is never named.

Owner decision (adj 647, key `toolfeedback.covered-by-landed`; Jon, session 8d711f67, 2026-11-27): still file the slice, then add a slicer note naming a done item with a near-identical title, like the possible-duplicate note. The match is by title, with no landing date. This slice also carries S639 (retired into S631; adj 626): the reviewer and gate Direction section lists open items under Likely duplicates by comparing titles as well as the slice's Why text (`internal/engine/brief.go:573`, `:690`). Evidence from S639: S530 asked for the same reviewer-brief sandbox line that S606 added, but Likely duplicates said none.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-27: adj 647 (link to a done item with a near-identical title; include S639) and adj 653 (reuse the Jaccard 0.5 rule for Likely duplicates).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/neardup.go`, move the Jaccard comparison out of `NearDuplicateTitles` into `similarTitles(a, b string, min float64) bool` (it uses `titleWords`). Rewrite `NearDuplicateTitles` to call it. Behavior and the three existing tests stay the same.
2. In the same file, add `NearDoneTitles(title, selfID string, items []slicercli.Item, min float64) []string`. It returns the ids of items whose status is exactly `done`, in list order, skipping `selfID`, using `similarTitles`. Retired and unfinished items are excluded.
3. In `internal/engine/toolfeedback.go`, in `FileToolFeedback` after the existing open-duplicate note (:288-293), compute `NearDoneTitles(t.Title, added.ID, items, nearDuplicateMin)` from the same `items`. When it is not empty, call `d.Slicer.Note(ctx, w, t.Project.Path, added.ID, "possibly covered by done "+strings.Join(done, ", "))`. Each note is written independently, so a failed open-duplicate note does not skip the done note. An error from either is recorded as `out[i].Err` with the `near duplicates: slicer note in PROJECT` text; the first error is kept. Add no field to `ToolFeedbackResult` or the run record: the note is the whole outcome (adj 647). The slice is still filed and promoted first, and an exact-key repeat (`added.Existing`) still adds no note.
4. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, in `directionSection` keep the current slice's title from its row in `items` (the loop at :541 skips it). In the loop at :569-580, list an open item under duplicates when `whyContainsTitle(why, entry.item.Title)` or `similarTitles(selfTitle, entry.item.Title, briefTitleDuplicateMin)`. Declare `briefTitleDuplicateMin` beside the other direction constants; its value is the owner's answer to the question below. Done and retired items are already excluded. Change the heading at :690 to name both rules: `Likely duplicates (at least 60% of title content words in this slice's Why, or a title like this slice's):`.
5. Write the tests listed under Failing tests first in `neardup_test.go`, `toolfeedback_test.go` and `brief_test.go`; reuse `nearFeedbackRun`'s shape (parameterize or copy it with the list rows and note exit as inputs) and `directionFixture`. Watch each fail, then make it pass.
6. In `docs/design.md`, extend the Possible duplicates bullet (:1603-1613) with the done-item note: `possibly covered by done ID, ID`, done items only, same Jaccard 0.5, no landing date (adj 647), not stored in `near`, a failed note is a `file_error`. In the Direction bullet (:2044-2050), say that Likely duplicates also include open items whose title is similar to the current slice's title (threshold chosen by the owner), using the same title-word normalization.
7. Run `slicer changelog add S631 --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork --text "New tool feedback filed as a slice now gets a note when a done item has a near-identical title, and the reviewer Direction section lists open items with a title like the slice's under Likely duplicates."` This writes `landed-changed/S631.md`. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.
